entries.description: Agent-readable description of the WebMCP tools the Quorly editor registers in the browser: read, list, open, create and edit documents, insert tables, and set reading preferences. Destructive actions keep an in-page confirmation step.
representativeQueries: read the document I have open in Quorly
append a summary to my Quorly draft
list the documents saved in this browser
set the editor to light mode with a wider column
insert a 4 by 2 table into the document
